home_title: Free AI, running on your computer
home_lead: Your AI tools can use free models from many providers through one local address. FreeAITokens picks a model for each request and moves on when one runs out.
play_empty: Ask anything. Each answer shows which provider and model gave it, and how long it took.
prompt_placeholder: Write a message… (⌘/Ctrl + Enter to send)
tools_lead: Open a coding tool in a new terminal window, already set up to use free models. Your tool's own settings stay as they are.
other_apps_text: Zed, JetBrains, VS Code, Cline, Continue and any app that takes an OpenAI-compatible address: paste the address and key from Home, and use the model free.
tool_opening: Opening {name} in a new terminal window.
prov_lead: Each provider you add gives you more free use. Keys stay in your computer's keychain.
usage_lead: Every call to a provider counts, including ones FreeAITokens retried elsewhere. Kept on this computer for 90 days.
no_requests: No requests in this range yet.
set_login_text: Open FreeAITokens in the background when you log in.
set_chats_text: Saved chats stay on this computer unless you turn on sync.
confirm_delete: Delete all saved chats? This cannot be undone.
set_key_text: The local token your apps use.
err_send: That message could not be sent.
err_model: That model is not available. Pick another one.
err_account: the Account ID is missing or not valid
menu_reused: Using the endpoint already running on port {port}
add_lead: Use your own account, one per provider. Keys are tested, then stored in your system keychain.
add_connect_text: Sign in to OpenRouter in your browser and approve the connection. No key to copy.
add_all_done: Every provider already has a key.
image_placeholder: Describe the picture you want… (⌘/Ctrl + Enter to create)
image_gone: This image's file is no longer on this computer.
svg_preview: Preview of the SVG code below
no_image_providers: To create images, add Cloudflare or OpenRouter. Both are free.
err_image: No picture came back. Try again or pick another model.
no_speech_providers: To make speech, add OpenRouter, Groq or Cloudflare. All are free.
no_transcription_providers: To transcribe audio, add Groq or Cloudflare. Both are free.
err_speech: No speech came back. Try again.
audio_too_big: That file is over 25 MB. Pick a shorter one.
set_theme_text: Light, dark, or the same as this computer.
sync_waiting: Finish paying in your browser. FreeAITokens picks up your key by itself.
sync_key_got: This is your sync key. Keep a copy: you need it on your other computers.
sync_pass_hint: At least 10 characters. It never leaves your computers, and nobody can reset it for you.
sync_pass_mismatch: The two passphrases are not the same.
sync_forgot: Forgot the passphrase? Use your recovery code
sync_recovery_text: If you forget your passphrase, this code lets you set a new one. Print it or keep it somewhere safe, away from this computer.
sync_pass_changed: Passphrase changed. Your other computers keep working.
sync_confirm_off: Stop syncing on this computer? Your chats and keys stay here.
sync_expired: Your sync plan has ended. Nothing new syncs until you renew, and your synced data is kept for 90 days.
sync_revoked: Sync stopped because the payment was refunded or disputed.
sync_wrong_pass: That passphrase does not open this sync key.
sync_bad_key: That is not a sync key. It looks like FAT-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX.
sync_bad_code: That recovery code does not open this sync key.
chat_too_long: This chat is too long to save. Start a new chat to keep going.
sync_confirm_new: This key isn't set up yet, so this passphrase will be its first. Type it again to make sure.
attach_file: Attach a document, data file or audio
file_too_big: That file is over 25 MB. Pick a smaller one.
err_file: This app can't read that file. Attach a PDF, text, CSV, JSON, code, a Word document (.docx) or audio.
doc_cut: Only the first part of this file was added: the whole of it is too long for one chat.
doc_empty: There's no text in this file to read. A scanned PDF holds pictures of pages, not text.
home_sync: Use FreeAITokens on more than one computer? Keep your chats and keys the same on all of them.
talk_title: Talk mode: what you say is sent, and the answer is read out
mic_denied: FreeAITokens can't use the microphone. Allow it in your computer's privacy settings, then try again.
voice_busy: {name} is busy right now. Try again in a minute.
voice_all_busy: Every voice provider you have is busy right now. Try again in a minute.
sync_lead: Your chats and provider keys on all your computers. The app and every provider stay free; Sync is the one paid part.
sync_perk_same: Chats and provider keys the same on every computer
sync_perk_private: Encrypted on your computer with your passphrase: the sync server can't read them
